artifacts.title: NBI Submittal Schema v04
notes: The FHWA page links the JSON schema used for 2026 and later submissions and says a new schema will precede 2028.
The exact JSON bytes linked by the FHWA schema page are vendored and SHA-256 verified.

The artifact declares https://json-schema.org/draft/2024-07/schema, which BridgeGuard does not silently reinterpret as a supported dialect; execution remains fail-closed until FHWA or an authorized standards profile resolves the dialect.

artifacts.title: SNBI Data Submittal Validation Logic version 1.1
notes: The source URL identifies the exact v1.1 XLSX bytes linked by the FHWA validation page, which describes distinct 2026/2027 and 2028 treatment.
The exact workbook bytes were locally vendored, SHA-256 verified, and its reviewed A:H rule-table layout was deterministically inventoried.
All 382 inventoried rule rows remain explicitly pending/unimplemented; no workbook prose was auto-compiled into executable validation and no FHWA/NBTIS validation claim is made.

artifacts.title: SNBI Data Submittal Validation Logic version 1.2
notes: FHWA's validation page identified the current publication as version 1.2 when observed on September 20, 2026.
The workbook downloaded from the official FHWA source URL on that date is byte-for-byte identical to the previously pinned version 1.1 workbook (same SHA-256 and 91,515-byte length).
Because the official bytes did not change, BridgeGuard retains the existing 382-row informational inventory and makes no claim that additional validation logic was compiled or executed.
